title: A KB-Work line outside the last paragraph is no trailer, and done then checks no commit
goal: backlog.py done refuses an item with touches when no commit on HEAD carries its KB-Work trailer, and the skills' commit examples put KB-Work in the last paragraph with the other trailers; a test plants a commit with KB-Work before a Co-Authored-By paragraph.
notes: Seen in sprint SP-z7a5c76b: commits 70a78af and da0bc12 put KB-Work in a paragraph before Co-Authored-By, so git reads no trailer and done's scope check passed on zero commits. The repro fails until the planted-commit test exists and passes.
